_comment: Hierarchical MILP AllGather on rail_optimized_256gpu with switch copy. 256 GPUs (32 hosts x 8), rail-optimized single plane: 8 leaves (one per rail) / 4 spines, 2:1 leaf taper, each leaf-spine edge 4 x 400Gbps cables. Hierarchical only. milp_chunking=4: one MILP chunk = 4 of a host's 8 identities for one destination-cell set, so 2 chunks per host -- between 'holder' (8, intractable here) and 'cell' (1, voids multipath across the 8 uplinks). Bundles span holder GPUs, so three GPUs of each group of four stage through the NVSwitch. switch_copy [true, false]: the network switches of the coarse level copy -- a fan-out is one Send, charged once on its uplink, and ncclize emits it as ONE multicast send threadblock (tb send="r1,r2") with one mscclflowid, plus a switch-JSON (format 2) entry listing every out port; the cell NVSwitches do not copy (multicast there needs NVLS). Pass --no-multicast to ncclize for the pre-multicast output (one unicast send per branch). SLOWEST_LINK keeps every coarse link at >= 1 chunk/epoch (occupancy 1: no multi-epoch legs). objective_type 6 (LEXICOGRAPHIC) puts makespan first; PAPER (3) ties on it. Outputs: Schedules/<prefix>_flat.json (+ _coarse/_identities/_intra side outputs). No warmstart and no objective_tier_time_limit: the solver as-is, for timing the formulation (the 2026-10-21 b2 run, before the max_ linearization and chunk symmetry breaking, found no incumbent in 4 h). num_epochs 8 IS the ingress bound (62 chunks into 8 in-links of 1 chunk/epoch), so no horizon past it can help; the leaf broadcast (2 columns per cell over 8 leaves) also takes 8, and the 2026-11-10 dual-plane b4_nows run (solved at 19) finished in exactly 8. symmetry false: no twin-switch flow-equality rows and no switch 'inflow == max(outs)' rule. Both restrict the model (neither is exact for a MILP), and the second costs a gp.max_ per copying-switch row. chunk_symmetry_breaking (default on) orders a host's interchangeable chunks instead, which is exact. See teccl/hierarchy/milp_design.md and teccl/ncclize/multicast_output_design.md.
